gameplan.summary: Control lane with hook threats, stack souls for scaling, and carry with Lantern + Death Sentence combos.
gameplan.win_condition: Create picks with Death Sentence then snowball. Peel for ADC in teamfights with Flay.
gameplan.early_game: Level 1 Q hook onto overextended targets. Level 2 all-in with E slow. Always collect souls.
gameplan.positioning: Roam constantly. Drop Lantern for teammates in danger. Save W for clutch plays.

blitzcrank.tips: Both want to hook first. Stand behind minions. If he hooks your ADC, E-slow him immediately.
blitzcrank.power_shift: You outscale him in soul stacking. Win long games with superior kit utility.

nautilus.tips: His Q root is hard CC — don't stand near walls. Poke him before he engages.
nautilus.power_shift: Both are engage supports. Win by landing Death Sentence before his Q.

lulu.tips: Her W polymorph stops your hook combo. Time Q when she wastes W on a minion.
lulu.power_shift: She outpokes you early. Win through roaming when she stays bot lane.

soraka.tips: Hook her freely — she has no mobility. Zone her from ADC so she can't heal. Ignite to counter Wish.
soraka.power_shift: You win all-ins with hook combos. She scales better if game goes past 30 min.

leona.tips: She has stronger burst CC at level 2. Play passive pre-6. Use Lantern to disengage her engage.
leona.power_shift: Even. Both are engage supports. Win through superior roaming and picks.
